title: Edit selected text
description: Give an instruction about text in another app. Review the result before replacing the original selection.
automaticCommands: Recognize edit commands during ordinary dictation
automaticHelp: Off by default. When enabled, Handy captures the current nonsecure selection and, where needed, a bounded field snapshot for local target checks. Only selected text is used for command generation. Explicit commands such as ‘make this shorter’ or ‘translate the selection into Spanish’ create a preview. You still confirm replacement.
automaticLimits: Recognition uses a local English grammar, with no cloud classifier. Quotes, narrative speech, unsupported languages, and uncertain requests remain dictation. Preview generation also requires a local provider. Use the dedicated shortcut for other instructions.
voiceHelp: Select text in the destination app, use the shortcut, and speak an instruction such as ‘make this shorter’. Stop recording to generate a preview. Nothing is pasted automatically.
captureHelp: Switch to the destination app and select the text now.
replaceHelp: Replacement checks the original app, field, and selection. If they changed or the target expired, capture the text again. Windows and Linux support plain-text fields only; rich formatting is not retained. This does not send messages or submit forms.
empty: No commands yet. Capture a selection or use the voice shortcut.
